verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Bruno's code lives in a public GitHub repository: the readme is served from raw.githubusercontent.com/usebruno/bruno and GitHub releases list individual feature commits. That suggests the source is publicly readable, but nothing in the pack states what license it is published under. missing for 10: any explicit statement of an open-source license (e.g. MIT/Apache), documentation of which parts of the product are open versus proprietary, independent corroboration of license openness.
